_principles: Title on top, evidence anchored to the bottom, air between them. The renderer measures blocks and places them; nothing sits on a hard-coded y.
One dominant element per slide: the title on argument slides, the evidence on evidence slides.
Variants are chosen by the renderer from the shape of the content. The agent chooses the job (layout), never the variant.
Primary is a surface only on the closing slide. Tint is the only secondary surface. Primary text appears as at most one class of elements per slide.
No images by default, no icons, no gradients, no shadows, square corners. Rules are 1 px, the table header rule is 2 px.
Russian typography is enforced in the renderer: short prepositions and the dash are glued to their neighbours, quotes are «», figures are tabular.

cover.job: State the promise and set the brand

shape.title: 1–3 display lines; the part after a line break is set in primary
shape.body: paragraph 1: lead ≤ 24 words (7 columns); paragraph 2 (optional): one meta line shown in the footer in mono

cover.composition: Poster: title anchored above the lead at the bottom of the frame, chrome at the top, no page counter competition. The blue ruler marks slide 1.

statement.job: Establish one principle after the evidence

shape.title: 1–2 display lines; the part after a line break is set in accent

statement.composition: Dark field, display title at the top, one consequence at the bottom. Max one per deck; never before the first evidence slide.

closing.job: Ask for one concrete next action
closing.composition: Blue field, paper title at the top, the action at the bottom. The only slide where primary is a surface.

content.job: Explain one idea or two to four arguments

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines
shape.body: One plain paragraph, or 2–4 paragraphs separated by a blank line; first line of each argument is its name (h2), the rest is one sentence (small)

variants.fact-rows: Evidence-role content with 2–4 named facts: readable label left, explanation right, measured rows anchored to content bottom; tries tighter row spacing without reducing type, then falls back to cols if rows do not fit.
variants.lead: One paragraph in body type across seven columns, expanding to ten only when needed
variants.cols: 2, 3 or 4 equal columns spanning the frame; each column opens with a 1 px ink rule and a mono index

content.selection: One paragraph selects lead. Evidence-role content with 2–4 named paragraphs tries fact-rows, otherwise cols. The renderer checks measured height before choosing rows.

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines
shape.body: 2–4 paragraphs; first line is the step name

variants.cols: same geometry as content.cols; indices are mandatory and ordered

split.job: Show the same thing in two states, or two options side by side

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines, states the takeaway (not the quote)
shape.comparison: structured: { mode?: 'neutral' | 'correction', prompt?: {label, text}, before: {label, text}, after: {label, text}, status?: string }
shape.body: optional caption (≤ 16 words) shown under the prompt or in the footer

variants.before-after: directional. Left 4 columns: prompt label + quote + caption. Right 8 columns: tint card with a readable 'before' and bold 'after'. Set mode:'neutral' for processes or alternatives: no strike-through, both texts in ink. Use mode:'correction' only to replace erroneous text: struck-through 'before' in muted. Missing mode preserves the legacy correction appearance; labels in mono; the 'after' label is the one primary text on the slide. Without a prompt the card spans 12 columns.
variants.options: symmetric. Two 6-column blocks with a 1 px rule, a mono label and 40 px text; neither side is emphasised.

split.selection: comparison present → before-after; otherwise body with exactly two 'label\ntext' paragraphs → options; anything else is rejected

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines
shape.table: 2–4 columns, ≤ 6 rows; columnRoles optional: key | text | meta | number (first column defaults to key)
shape.body: optional one-line caption shown in the footer in mono

variants.auto: index column 88 px in mono; key columns prefer 3–4 grid columns in 28 px bold, with all widths constrained to the shared frame; text columns share the rest proportionally to their measured content; multiline headers reserve their measured height; meta columns are muted; number columns are right-aligned

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines
shape.body: optional one-line caption shown in the footer in mono

variants.facts: spec-sheet rows: mono label in 4 columns, '<value> <unit>' in 40 px bold in 8 columns, rules between rows. For scope and parameters.
variants.hero: up to 4 columns with 96 px numerals, the unit in 40 px and the label in small. Only for measured quantities.

metrics.selection: hero only when every metric has a sourceId and (|value| ≥ 10 or unit contains %); otherwise facts

shape.title: h1, ≤ 2 lines
shape.body: caption with the source or the data caveat, shown in the footer

variants.bars: horizontal rows: label in 3 columns, signed bar from a 1 px ink zero line in 6 columns, value in mono right-aligned in 3 columns; positive bars primary, negative muted; row heights measure the full label and value
variants.bars-wide-labels: labels widen to 4 or 5 grid columns while bars use 5 or 4; values retain 3 columns; content and font sizes are preserved

chart.selection: start with bars; if measured rows exceed the two-line heading budget or a label token does not fit, try wider labels; the final measured content must also fit below the actual title

image.job: Show real evidence supplied by the customer

variants.right: image in the right 8 columns at 16:9, anchored to the content bottom; text in the left 4 columns, bottom-aligned
